import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

# Load the data
customer_segments = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Encode categorical variables
label_encoder = LabelEncoder()
customer_segments['Education'] = label_encoder.fit_transform(customer_segments['Education'])
customer_segments['Marital_Status'] = label_encoder.fit_transform(customer_segments['Marital_Status'])

# Select relevant features for PCA
pca_features = ['Income', 'MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds', 
                'NumDealsPurchases', 'NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases', 'NumWebVisitsMonth', 
                'Z_Revenue']

# Apply PCA
pca = PCA(n_components=2)
pca_data = pca.fit_transform(customer_segments[pca_features])

# Create a DataFrame with the principal components
pca_df = pd.DataFrame(pca_data, columns=['Principal_Component_1', 'Principal_Component_2'])

# Merge the DataFrame with the original DataFrame
customer_segments_pca = pd.concat([customer_segments[['Education', 'Marital_Status', 'Response']], pca_df], axis=1)

# Convert categorical variables to numerical variables
customer_segments_pca['Education'] = customer_segments_pca['Education'].astype(float)
customer_segments_pca['Marital_Status'] = customer_segments_pca['Marital_Status'].astype(float)

# Create a scatter plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Principal_Component_1', y='Principal_Component_2', hue='Response', palette='viridis', data=customer_segments_pca)
plt.title('Customer Segmentation')
plt.xlabel('Principal Component 1')
plt.ylabel('Principal Component 2')
plt.legend(title='Response')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
